title: CVKita
description: A free CV and cover letter builder. Users enter their details in a guided editor, choose a template or create their own design, preview the documents, and download watermark-free PDFs. Document generation runs entirely in the browser, with no account or backend required.
highlights: Responsive editor for personal details, work experience, education, skills, certifications, and languages, with document preview and validation before download
Five ready-made templates and a custom design studio for colors, typography, photo placement, section order, and decorative image layers
Optional cover letters and drawn signatures, exported as separate PDF documents
A4 PDF export with selectable text, automatic pagination, and support for photos and decorative images
Drafts saved automatically in localStorage; CV data, photos, and signatures stay in the user's browser
